name: Smart and Skilled concession fee (Centrelink recipients)
summary: NSW students on a Commonwealth benefit, and their dependants, pay a capped concession fee for Smart and Skilled certificate courses.
key: The concession fee varies up to $240, depending on the qualification level.
who: Receive a Commonwealth Government benefit, or are a recognised dependant of a recipient.
how: Give your training provider a current Centrelink income statement or Pensioner Concession Card; TAFE NSW can check with your CRN.
catches: No concession fees apply to Diplomas and Advanced Diplomas.

source.label: Skills NSW: Commonwealth Government benefit recipients
